name: one-more-film
description: ONE MORE launch film (Remotion). Independent of the website build.

scripts.render:landscape: npm run sfx && remotion render LaunchLandscape out/one-more-16x9.mp4
scripts.render:vertical: npm run sfx && remotion render LaunchVertical out/one-more-9x16.mp4
scripts.render:square: npm run sfx && remotion render LaunchSquare out/one-more-1x1.mp4
scripts.render:all: npm run render:landscape && npm run render:vertical && npm run render:square
scripts.render:web: npm run sfx && remotion render LaunchLandscape out/one-more-web.mp4 --muted --crf=28 && remotion still LaunchLandscape out/one-more-poster.jpg --frame=1000
